name: Flame Street, Eastern End
desc1: This wide, litter-cluttered street is paved with broken and chipped
desc2: flagstones. Tall, rickety buildings tower above on either side of the
desc3: street, their barred and curtained windows disquietingly watchful.
desc4: Flickering light is provided by lit torches fastened to the walls. A
desc5: strange-looking store to the south has a large red eye emblazoned on
desc6: its door, and an empty-looking building stands to the north. The
desc7: street continues to the west, and opens into an alleyway to the east.
